title: Chapter 416 Shura Set
content:
Chapter 416 Shura Set

Matar drove all the other blacksmiths to another place, and only the two of them were left in the blacksmith shop.

Udon was standing at the door, guarding the door eagerly. He also wanted to go in, but he didn't dare to go in because of his master's order.

Wang Shuo was also a little amused. It was a pity that he couldn't forge iron, otherwise, he would be almost the same as them.

It was a very complicated thing to make the Shura suit, otherwise it wouldn't be possible. Only the master-level blacksmith was qualified to make it.

Wang Shuo was full of expectations when the master personally took action.

Wang Shuo returned to his residence and waited patiently.

…

At the same time, the situation in the Shenwu Empire changed suddenly.

The old emperor passed away!

History is always surprisingly similar. More than a thousand years ago, the old emperor of the North Sea Empire passed away and the empire fell apart.

This time, the Shenwu Empire, which inherited most of the territory of the North Sea Empire, also faced the same situation.

The most important reason is that the area of the empire is too large to be managed uniformly. This model of vassal states is very easy to cultivate some potential opponents.

Especially in the small vassal states, there appeared the Sword God, the Knife Emperor, the Gun God, and other strongest king-level strongmen, one person can destroy a small country.

Small countries will quickly evolve into big countries, and then threaten the Central Empire.

If the Central Empire is in an unstable internal situation at this time, such as internal power struggles, political corruption, etc., then the external vassal states will become external threats.

The old emperor of the Shenwu Empire passed away, the eldest prince Min Dan was killed by his younger brother, the second prince, and the other princes fled in a hurry. With the support of their own forces, they all claimed to be orthodox.

The princes sought support from the vassal states almost overnight.

The Shenwu Empire was divided into four major factions.

The second prince, the third prince, the seventh prince and the neutral faction.

Of course, the lords near the Iron Great Wall in the extreme south of the Shenwu Empire naturally have no time to care about the affairs of the Shendu, which is tens of thousands of miles away.

They are not qualified to care.

Liu Hong is now only thinking about how to unify the nearby forces and then establish a country.

Dongfang Ke, Wang Zhu and even the three county governors in the Dahuai area were thinking about how to deal with the upcoming threat.

All forces were gearing up, and war seemed to be the eternal theme of this continent.

Wang Shuo was also stepping up his training. After being promoted to an intermediate general, Wang Shuo also upgraded his qualifications to S-level.

The equivalent level of an intermediate general is 80 to 90, and Wang Shuo's level has reached 83 at this time.

Two of the sets of skills, "Black Dragon Sutra" has been cultivated to the sixth level, and "Dragon Spear Method" has been cultivated to the fifth level, and it is almost time to break through the sixth level.

...

Seven days later, someone reported to Wang Shuo that Master Tongchui had completed the Shura suit.

Wang Shuo was extremely excited.

He hurried to the blacksmith shop.

In the blacksmith shop, Matar was serving Master Tongchui tea.

Next to him, a set of armor was hung on a bracket, and a long spear was erected next to it.

The whole set of armor was black gold. A closer look showed that the patterns on it formed a complex formation, as if it was made by nature.

"Red Eyed Shura, try your armor!"

Master Tongchui took a sip of tea and said with a smile.

After Wang Shuo thanked him, he immediately put on the armor.

Instantly, his temperament changed drastically.

Wang Shuo immediately checked his attributes.
